scope: PR whole-file fallback regression and LZMA dictionary/memory admission; incremental release feedback, no claim of complete ssconvert parity.
findings: The original PR fallback retained Infinity before readFile, rejecting valid unlimited reads and preventing cancellation/getter lifecycle admission. Nine original lifecycle/getter failures plus the supplemental regression were independently reproduced. Upstream d595e2307860f6f15989f878f85177c6b3be0254 delivered the same runtime repair before integration; upstream source was kept exactly.

The PR supplement covers default unlimited reads, explicit input and retained-byte limits, exact output, admission refusal, original-byte preservation and cleanup. Independent40data/failure/cancellation controls plus4shared-budget controls preserve exact accounting after integration.

The original three LZMA failures assumed an obsolete8MiB default dictionary cap. Upstream381ad137df4c2d11926ad253f73538c74c2f96c3 corrected basic assertions; supplemental tests retain all6small real decode vectors and original offset8=255 as uint32dictionary0xff800000.

NaN,-1,fractional and2^32 dictionaries reject before factory acquisition. Valid dictionaries including0xff800000/0xffffffff use inert injected modules without giant native allocation. Dictionaries8388609/0xff800000 reject under an explicit8MiB native memory limit and release all owned allocation.

H02 and join failures were also independently reproduced, then resolved by upstream890369d4e and381ad137d. Stronger independent30controls preserve real confinement, hardlink refusal and caller-defined output/field boundaries; no duplicate runtime change was made.
